title: AI-Assisted Delivery (AI Coding Agents: GitHub Copilot, Claude Code)
summary: An emerging, current-relevance accomplishment theme, distinct from general AI/ML model building. This is the newest and fastest-evolving skill area in the entire knowledge base — worth watching closely as the US federal government agency engagement continues.
businessValue: At the US federal government agency, enabled a full application build within a compressed 2-3 month window that would otherwise have required a larger team or longer timeline. This represents a genuine shift in how Russell leads technical delivery: not just adopting AI tools personally, but building repeatable frameworks around them and leading teams through that adoption.

title: GIS (Geographic Information Systems)

businessValue: Delivered a full migration of a live, production GIS system (the US federal government agency recreation site data) off a legacy Oracle/ArcGIS Enterprise stack onto a redesigned, more performant PostgreSQL/PostGIS architecture, without disrupting the underlying land-unit and recreation-site management capability the US federal government agency depends on. Also delivered a proof-of-concept custom frontend GIS application (recreation site inventory + survey ticketing) integrated with the new database and ArcGIS, built rapidly using AI coding agents — though the client ultimately did not proceed past the POC stage due to budget constraints.
resumeBulletPoints: Led a multi-year (2023-2025) migration of a legacy Oracle/ArcGIS Enterprise land-unit database to PostgreSQL with PostGIS for the US federal government agency, redesigning the schema for performance
